verdict.rationale: Zulip's official API supports sending messages and has a documented bot framework with API keys/botserver deployment, which is the standard mechanism agents use to read and post messages. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of reading channel messages via the API or of scoped/restricted API tokens (e.g., per-channel or read-only key scoping). missing for 10: explicit docs on reading messages via API, explicit scoped-token/permission mechanism, independent confirmation of bot token scoping in practice.
